content: Recharts (npm latest 3.10.1): declarative JSX React API, most common choice for React dashboards, good TS types. Chart.js: smallest gzip footprint but canvas-based, less idiomatic in React. Nivo: modular per-chart packages (@nivo/pie npm latest 0.99.0) but heavier if importing multiple chart families. For a single pie/donut chart, bundle delta between these is marginal.
